scenes.hook: One click, one number higher. Build this counter with JavaScript.
scenes.idea: The page needs a button and an output element. Start the displayed number at zero.
scenes.code: Select both elements after the page exists, and store zero in a variable called count.
scenes.result: Add a click listener. Each click increases count, then text content updates the number on screen.
scenes.tip: Watch the value change from zero to one, then two. The variable and display stay in sync.
scenes.caution: Changing the variable alone will not update the page. You must update the output too.
scenes.try: Your challenge: add a reset button that sets both the value and display back to zero.
scenes.close: Subscribe to Tech at sixty for the next coding project.
